A1.justification: Both PDFs describe LASQ and provide readable main text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–G. The reduction from 23 to 21 pages reflects a shorter bibliography, not missing supplementary material.

before.justification: V1 reports original LASQ enhancement results, computational measurements, ablations and cross-dataset evaluations in Tables 1–6 and accompanying figures.

after.justification: V2 retains the original LASQ experiments, quantitative results and qualitative comparisons, including the appendix evaluations.

M1.justification: The stated forward diffusion mechanism changes substantially. V1 adds a learnable drift term tau_t times Delta_mu_t to each transition; v2 removes it and assigns hierarchical features as x0 for temporal intervals. Algorithm 1 changes accordingly. This revises a central training component, while luminance sampling, losses and inference remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use LOLv1, LSRW, DICM, NPE, VV, LIME and MEF. The appendix retains the same cross-dataset training study and nocturnal/overexposure examples; no dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The comparator sets in Tables 1, 2 and 5 and the qualitative figures are unchanged, including LightenDiffusion and the computational-cost comparator WCDM. Renumbered citations still identify the same works.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.2 and Appendices D–E retain the same reported metrics, data preparation, training settings and transfer-evaluation setup, including T=1000 and N=100. The forward-process revision changes the proposed method without a separately reported evaluation-protocol change.

E4.justification: The fixed-luminance and limited-hierarchy ablations, hyperparameter sensitivity study, cross-dataset pretraining analysis and challenging-scene comparisons are retained unchanged in Tables 3, 4 and 6 and Figures 5 and 10.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, experimental seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. There is no change in statistical uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: All six tables retain their numerical entries, and the qualitative figure images are identical. For example, Table 1 retains LASQ's LOLv1 PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS of 20.375/0.814/0.191. No reported result is added, removed or revised despite the changed method description.

T1.justification: Section 3.3 replaces the drift-conditioned transition and asserted closed-form marginal with a temporal partition, interval-dependent x0 assignment and ordinary Gaussian transition. Removing the weighted hierarchical marginal and changing the central probabilistic formulation is substantive mathematical revision, not equivalent notation.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets and conclusion retain the same claims about physics-aware statistical luminance modeling, unsupervised hierarchical diffusion, optional normal-light references and fidelity/generalization advantages. Their scientific scope is unchanged.

C2.justification: V2 explains hierarchical guidance through interval-specific illumination references and associates it with adaptive noise scheduling. Appendix A removes the explanation based on weighted aggregation and explicit hierarchical feature cues during reverse denoising. Experimental interpretations and Appendix F limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Algorithm 1 revises the implementation recipe: initialization changes from F_H^(1) to F_H^(0), and the forward loop assigns a hierarchical x0 before sampling without the drift. Software, hardware, numerical hyperparameters, preprocessing details and the project-page disclosure remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The bibliography contracts from 70 to 48 entries, removing uncited entries including Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models and the Metropolis–Hastings reference. Retained in-text citations map to the same works, and the related-work arguments and novelty positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Rewriting is concentrated in Section 3.3 and the corresponding Appendix A explanation, alongside citation renumbering. The section sequence, contribution narrative, experimental discussion and remaining appendices are substantially preserved.

P2.justification: The revised equations and pseudocode produce limited formatting changes, and Appendix A text reflows around Figure 7. All ten figures and six tables retain their images, designs, captions and organization; there is no substantial visual redesign.

improvement.justification: V2 simplifies the forward equations and updates Algorithm 1, but how interval-dependent x0 reassignment affects the recursive transition remains unclear. The new F_H^(0) initialization is also outside the stated feature indexing from 1 to N. The unchanged experiments do not establish how the revised formulation relates to the evaluated implementation. These unresolved technical effects prevent a reliable net-quality judgment despite limited bibliographic cleanup.
